text_block_list.text:
The day of the Spring Fan Thanksgiving—today, Sakura Bakushin O is performing in a mini-live.
While I was helping her prepare for it...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Bakushin O-san!
I've finished checking the live stage!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, thank you very much!
Now then, anyone with free hands, please help prepare the pamphlets!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Baku-chan has truly become a senior now, hasn't she?
The way that girl looks at Baku-chan
is just sparkling with admiration♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you can always count on her!
...Alright! I'll do my best preparing too,
so the 'Bakushin Mini-Live' will be a huge success~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now then, all that's left is Baku-chan's prep!
Shall we do your nails before you put on the outfit?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It dries quickly, but please stay still for a little while after applying it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me!
I'll stay more exemplary still than anyone else!"
choice_data_list: Shall I fan it so it dries a bit faster?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu.
Even so, it somehow feels deeply moving.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"When I was younger and we held an event at the Victory Club,
it was pure chaos right from the preparations!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's right!
Back then, I'm pretty sure Baku-chan was—

text_block_list.name: Young Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I hear someone calling for the Class Rep over there!
I'm on my way!
(CRASH-BASH-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Young Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Mama!
Baku-chan fell into the yo-yo fishing pool!?

text_block_list.name: Young Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What a big drum! Class Rep will help carry it too!

text_block_list.name: Young Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah, whoa!
It's dangerous to carry that alone!
Wait for meeeee!
choice_data_list: I can picture it so clearly~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, she was such a cute, hard worker,
so eager and full of energy to help out~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, a lot happened when we put up
the club's banner too, right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Everyone was in a total panic back then too!
Right, Baku-cha—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Baku-chan?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Baku-chan?!
Oh no! Breathe!! Breathe, please--!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Pfft, BWAHAHA!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*... Oh my...
Your nails... aren't done yet...!
Well then, once more――
choice_data_list: W-Wait! Why do I need to hold my breath!?
W-Wait! Why do I need to hold my breath!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask?
Well, of course—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's for standing completely still!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Aaah...! Baku-chan, you've still got that habit, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, when we were prepping for the club event,
we put up a banner at the entrance, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san gave her all trying to follow Teacher's instructions to
"Hold the banner right there and stay still," and as a result—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I stayed completely still with all my might!!
Held my breath too!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: After all, to stay completely still at full power, you have to keep absolutely everything still!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu... But somehow, it makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even after growing up and becoming a senpai,
that straightforward side of yours hasn't changed a bit, Baku-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san's straightforwardness
is the source of our energy and courage!
choice_data_list: That's our Class Rep for you!
As expected of the class rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san's straightforwardness
is the source of our energy and courage!
choice_data_list: That's our Class Rep for you!
As expected of the class rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Even if I end up all wrinkled,
I will always remain a role model for everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! This is truly what they mean by
"Bakushin's hoofprints last a lifetime"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, everyone! Whether you're feeling down or full of energy!
All together now!
--Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushin♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Breathe...? But if I breathe,
my body moves!
choice_data_list: I'll give you the signal when it's time to move!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ho! What a splendid idea!!
Let us do it at once!! Right this instant!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Bwaaaahh!!!
*inhalllllllllllllllllllllle*!!!!!
